Moonlight Run

Ready to run? The character only moves when you do. Pick a difficulty — it applies to all four levels.

Difficulty

Medium: the classic run — standard length, speed, and hazards.

Best score: 0

  • Run: hold Right / D or RUN; Left / A or LEFT to go back.
  • Jump: Space / Up / W or JUMP — press again mid-air to double jump.
  • Crouch: hold Down / S or the CROUCH button to duck low — paper airplanes thrown while crouched fly at ground level and hit ground walkers, and flyers pass over you. Throws while standing fly lower too.
  • Climb & platforms: ladders (hold Up / W, Down / S, or CLIMB / DOWN) and stairs lead to upper routes. Ride moving platforms; red bounce pads launch you high.
  • Pickups: stars 25 pts, coins 10 pts; chain them for a combo up to ×5. Hidden stars are worth 100.
  • Power-ups: shield blocks one hit, magnet pulls pickups in, extra jump adds a mid-air jump, and a paper airplane power-up lets you throw paper airplanes that shoot enemies down — F key or the SHOOT button while it lasts.
  • Checkpoint: pass the halfway flag to restart there after a hit — restarting from the checkpoint is always free.
  • Obstacles & enemies: dodge rocks, crates and other hazards, plus patrolling paperwork stacks, cancelled policies and system crashes, and storm clouds overhead — one touch ends the run.
  • Goal: reach the flag to finish each level — Meadow Day, Desert Sunset, Moonlit Night, City at Dusk.

How to play

  • Hold the Right Arrow or D key (or hold the RUN button) to run right. Hold the Left Arrow or A key (or the LEFT button) to move back.
  • Press Space, the Up Arrow, or W (or tap JUMP) to jump. Press it again in mid-air for a double jump.
  • Hold the Down Arrow or S (or hold the CROUCH button) to crouch low while on the ground. Throwing while crouched flies at ground level, so paper airplanes can hit ground walkers, and crouching lowers your body so flying enemies can pass over you. Throws while standing fly a little lower than before too.
  • Jump onto the platforms to reach the stars and coins — stars are worth 25 points, coins 10 points. Chaining pickups in a row builds a combo multiplier, and a few hidden stars tucked off the main path are worth 100 points each.
  • Power-ups appear along the way: a shield blocks one hit, a magnet pulls nearby stars and coins toward you for a while, an extra jump grants one more mid-air jump, and a paper airplane power-up lets you throw paper airplanes that fell enemies — hold F or the SHOOT button while it lasts. Pass the checkpoint flag halfway through a level and, if you are hit, you restart from there for free with the score you had when you passed it.
  • Ladders and stairs lead up to rooftops and high ledges with their own stars and coins: stand at a ladder and hold Up / W (or the CLIMB button) to climb, Down / S (or DOWN) to come back down. Some platforms slide or float — ride them — and red bounce pads spring you up to high pickups.
  • Dodge the obstacles and patrolling enemies — touching one ends the run — and reach the checkered flag to finish each level. Finish all four levels to win.
